description: messh 0.2.0 conformance vectors: RFC 9421 HTTP message signatures for any message, RFC 8941 structured fields, Web Bot Auth agents beyond messh identities, and signed key directories. Expected values are written by hand from the RFCs (spec/vectors/gen/httpsig.go); the generator only signs them.

sign.name: rfc9421-b26-ed25519
sign.label: sig-b26
sign.expected_base:
"date": Tue, 20 Apr 2021 02:07:55 GMT
"@method": POST
"@path": /foo
"@authority": example.com
"content-type": application/json
"content-length": 18
"@signature-params": ("date" "@method" "@path" "@authority" "content-type" "content-length");created=1618884473;keyid="test-key-ed25519"

sign.name: parameters-and-derived-components
sign.label: sig1

"@query-param";name="baz": batman
"example-dict";key="b": 2;x=1;y=2
"example-dict";sf: a=1, b=2;x=1;y=2, c=(a b c)
"example-header";bs: :dmFsdWUsIHdpdGgsIGxvdHM=:, :b2YsIGNvbW1hcw==:
"@target-uri": https://www.example.com/path?param=value&foo=bar&baz=batman&qux=
"@scheme": https

web_bot_auth.notes: Build a verifier with the trust list, the registry, required components when given, the clock at now, and a directory resolver that answers from directories (agent URL → key names). Inline keys need no resolver.
